subject: My tree-freeze check is blind to gitignored paths, and _tools is gitignored
description:
Found 2026-09-03 when a reviewer disclosed writing _tools/hexos/_reviewer_probe_tmp.test.js during a review. I verified the freeze all session with 'git status --short -- _app _tools/hexos' and reported '0 modified' as proof nothing had changed under the reviewer. That check CANNOT see _tools, because .gitignore:48 ignores it (confirmed with git check-ignore -v). So the file existed the whole time and my freeze report was true about tracked state and misleading about the tree. Nobody was harmed here: post-verify names each hexos gate explicitly rather than globbing *.test.js (verified), so a stray test file cannot break a deploy. But the verification method is wrong in a way that would matter if a reviewer overwrote a real gate. FIX: freeze checks over _tools must use 'git status --ignored --short' or a direct mtime/checksum comparison, not plain git status. ALSO: _tools/hexos/_reviewer_probe_tmp.test.js is on disk now and rm is denied to me; it needs an operator delete along with the other probe debris in taskboard 328.
[2026-09-03 21:20] Fixed in b84435616. git status is silent on gitignored paths BY DESIGN, and --ignored does not help (it lists what IS ignored, never what CHANGED -- git keeps no baseline for untracked files). Built _tools/deploy/freeze-check.sh: sha256 snapshot/verify, exit contract 0=identical 1=different 2=could-not-compare. Round 1 was BLOCKED by Nancy for printing FROZEN exit 0 against a truncated manifest; every degraded-baseline path now exits 2. 19-case self-test in freeze-check.selftest.sh.
